mechanism: Both agents can increase photosensitivity risk; levofloxacin is a known photosensitizing fluoroquinolone and tazarotene (a retinoid) increases skin photosensitivity and retinoid dermatitis.
action: Advise patients to use strict sun protection (SPF 30+), protective clothing, and avoid excessive UV exposure during concurrent use; monitor for phototoxic reactions.
